title: Mandäische Liturgien (German, Lidzbarski 1920)
author: Mark Lidzbarski
description: Mark Lidzbarski's German presentation of Mandaean liturgical material. The collection offers access to prayers and ritual language through which this religious tradition expresses its relationship with the world of light.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (EPUB from PDF). Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/mandaische-liturgien).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
